structured_output.what_is_happening: A pump.fun coin called 'Never Kill Yourself' (NEVER), about 10 minutes old and still on the bonding curve. Its description says trading fees go to the 988 Lifeline through UsePaid. It ran to about $34k (ATH price 3.44e-5), fell about 55% to about $15.6k, and is now bouncing: +10-14% over 5 minutes, with heavy volume in the latest 5 minutes. Among the 350 holders, the top 10 own about 24% (not counting the curve itself). The dev has sold out (creator_close). The dev has launched 5 tokens before, and the best of them peaked at about $34k. The name has been cloned many times before.

narrative.description: 'Never Kill Yourself' is a charity/anti-suicide meme, with trading fees routed to the 988 Lifeline through UsePaid. It links to a tweet from MostGentleDev.
narrative.why_spreading: A feel-good charity-fee angle, plus a phrase that keeps coming back as a meme. The many earlier clones that died near $3k suggest the theme has repeatedly failed to hold attention.

token_connection.why_this_token: It links to the specific MostGentleDev tweet and the UsePaid charity page, and it is the only copy with meaningful current liquidity and volume.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 8 other NEVER / 'Never Kill Yourself' tokens exist, mostly dead near $3.4k market cap. Ct9kK... had about $10k of volume in the last hour and launched about 40 minutes before this one. A 2xaW... copy from about 2026-07 sits at a $4.7k market cap.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN tags 110 of 289 traders as bundlers, and the top bundler traders hold about 30%. The bot/degen share is 36%. Breadth is decent: GeckoTerminal counts 375 unique buyers and 224 sellers in about 11 minutes. There are no paid DexScreener boosts or ads, no snipers and no rat-trader wallets. Seven smart wallets are present, but there are no smart-money signals and no KOL calls. A 'community takeover' flag on a token only 10 minutes old is odd.
authenticity.uncertainty: There are no X posts, so I can't tell whether the linked tweet is getting organic traction. The bundler tags may reflect multi-buy tools rather than coordinated supply.

structural_risks: Bundler wallets are about 38% of traders and top bundlers hold about 30% of supply, so a coordinated dump could hit the curve.
The token is already down about 55% from its ATH, so buyers from the first leg are trapped overhead.
It is still on the bonding curve at 64 of 115 virtual SOL; a thin curve means sharp moves both ways.
The dev is a serial launcher (5 tokens, best ATH about $34k) and has already sold out.
Many same-name clones split attention and cause ticker confusion.

structured_output.counterargument: The token only has to reach about $31k to hit the take-profit, which is below the $34k ATH it already set. Breadth is real: 375 unique buyers, and buys beat sells about 1.6 to 1. The last 5 minutes are accelerating and price is recovering. Charity-fee coins can draw sympathetic, viral attention on X. With the dev out and mint and freeze renounced, the usual dev-dump risk is gone. A second leg to a new high on the curve is plausible for a coin with this much early flow.
unknowns: Whether the MostGentleDev tweet has organic reach
Whether bundler-held supply is sold in coordination
Why the token is flagged as a community takeover so early
Whether the UsePaid fee routing to 988 is real and verifiable

structured_output.thesis: This is a recycled charity meme that has already made its first pump-and-dump, from about $34k to about $15.6k, and is now bouncing. Heavy bundler presence and many dead clones point to a fade, but the take-profit sits below the ATH and early breadth is decent, so a retest is possible. I rate its runner odds as moderate-to-low, around the middle of this pool.
